access_boundary: This record represents the Veo 3.1 preview release identified by the Gemini API model code veo-3.1-generate-preview, released October 15, 2025 and listed with an earliest shutdown date of October 22, 2026 and gemini-omni-1.1-flash as its recommended replacement. The Veo 3.1 Fast and Veo 3.1 Lite previews, the generally available veo-3.1-generate-001 on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, the Gemini Omni Flash line, and later video releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
